gen-dafont-redux-gf-noto-sans-georgian: Noto Sans Georgian leaves its curves open and trims its ascender stems short. And Redux does the showy work, spacing letters out and giving every curve a visible lead-in, while the body just reads.
gen-dafont-redux-gf-noto-sans-glagolitic: Noto Sans Glagolitic rounds its letters open and stands its lowercase tall and sturdy, clear at small sizes. Redux leads, widely spaced, its arch shoulders thinning slowly into lighter joins, while the body backs it up.
gen-dafont-redux-gf-noto-sans-grantha: Noto Sans Grantha runs tall little letters with flattened, open bowls. Redux is the showpiece, pairing sturdy thin lines with slightly heavier thick ones, while the body's job is a read that never snags.
gen-dafont-redux-gf-noto-sans-gunjala-go: Tall, crayon-thick lowercase strokes and terminals cut back to a wide gap make this body read open. Noto Sans Gunjala Gondi sits under Redux, whose widely spaced letters carry only a light touch of stroke modulation.
gen-dafont-redux-gf-noto-sans-hanunoo: Lowercase fills most of the height here, with open terminals. Noto Sans Hanunoo feels hushed beside Redux, whose hairlines stay fairly sturdy next to the stems and whose letters spread wide.
gen-dafont-redux-gf-noto-sans-hebrew: Redux gives every curved letter a pronounced entrance, and its arches thin slightly at the stem. And Noto Sans Hebrew, with its dominant midsection and wide curve gaps, carries paragraphs along without a snag.
gen-dafont-redux-gf-noto-sans-hk: Noto Sans HK has large lowercase forms with tight ascender clearance and brush ends lifted before curves close. Redux, with its half-turned flat-brush contrast, hands over to a body that reads steadily page after page.
gen-dafont-redux-gf-noto-sans-imperial-a: Redux carries soft contrast through every one of its curves. It does its best work big and widely spaced, while Noto Sans Imperial Aramaic stays open, its c ends pointing apart.
gen-dafont-redux-gf-noto-sans-inscriptio: Redux spaces its letters wide and flexes its contrast lightly, like a spring wire. Noto Sans Inscriptional Parthian brings big open eyes and a deep middle band to hold the lines beneath it.
gen-dafont-redux-gf-noto-sans-kaithi: Noto Sans Kaithi reads wide and generous, its e's open channel and lowercase forms filling the line like capitals. Redux earns its keep when set big and short, with low-to-medium contrast.
